input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal sits at our preferred position. Order Form renewals are successive twelve-month periods (no multi-year auto-renewal), Customer may opt out on thirty days' written notice (well inside the 30-day preferred ceiling), Vendor must send a renewal reminder at least sixty days beforehand (with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed), and renewal uplift is capped at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with no increase on prepaid periods. Section 7 contains no separate escalator. Nothing here fails the fallback, so no redline is warranted.
